body:
I am writing during 10+ min into the experience.
I have taken 20 mg's Cyclobenzaprine 48 hours ago (alcohol and nicotine) and 10 mg's 24 hours ago (just nicotine)... Calculation is that I still have on average around 10 mg in my system (roughly calculated in my head). I have also felt a pleasent feeling every time I drink caffeine that last 24 hours when I wake up in the morning.
Recollection:
T+00 Drank 6 shots of vodka fun buzz, just the normal.
Now:
T+1.25 had a full mouth of chew, feeling of an alcohol buzz has left, but no sober feeling.
T+1.35 a sober feeling has come over me, and I know it's only temporary as I spit out my chew.
T+1.55 I take 10mg cyclobenzaprine... Read other reports on it. I know from research that I should never mix MAOI's with cyclobenzaprine... Which chew has in it. I should also never mix alcohol. We will see how this goes...
T+2.10 I am feeling an alcohol buzz come back, which is weird because it feels like I drank another 6 shots... But smoother. I feel relaxed, focused (rare with ADD) and time is moving so slow... Also note that I have stopped drinking 2 hours ago.
T+2.15 feeling normal with an alcohol afterglow. I'm not willing to take anymore drugs, so we will see what happens.
T+2.20 I can see things better, or rather, looking at things makes me feel better. Staring at things makes my brain think about things that I would never normally think about.
T+2.25 feeling energized, like taking dexadrine, no euphoria, just energized. Time for another full gob of chew.
T+2.45 I am feeling sleepy, and my buzz is gone. I still have chew in my mouth but I have not spit once (I think I have dry mouth but it doesn't feel like it).
T+2.50 I feel excess seratonin. Sounds are more clear. I feel different, calm, good, but sober.
T+3.00 I'm hungry, time for bed. Still feel the buzz. Not sleepy anymore. I have to force myself to bed.
